source.note: Measured CI minutes per file of the nightly MCP mutation gate: the wall time of the mutation phase on a GitHub-hosted runner at the concurrency it ran, split by file. packages/xezar/mutation/shards.mjs packs shards on these numbers and holds every multi-file shard to its minute budget. This first minute snapshot was read off Stryker's own progress lines in each shard's job log (the tested count at each file boundary of the report's mutant order), because no shard wrote a timing.json yet; every later refresh comes from timing.json (packages/xezar/mutation/timing-reporter.mjs). See docs/testing/coverage-gaps.md § 10.8.
source.refresh: npm run --silent test:mutation:mcp:weights -- --reports <dir> --run <id> --revision <sha> --date <yyyy-mm-dd>, after downloading every mutation-report-* artifact of one nightly run (see packages/xezar/mutation/weights.mjs).
